notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Update 2 changes/fixes

-Shorten Healer Offensive Special time
-Added new menu UI
-Added new Pause and Shop UI
-Fixed crash when player leaves HowToPlay Character Select
-Fixed Wave mode trigger after 4th boss
-Fixed door UI to detect whether the player is on keyboard or Gamepad
- New Rogue Mode levels
- Spawners now spawn when attacked
- Fire and Ice boss damage hitboxes adjusted
-Fixed Ice boss underling soft lock not waking.
-Added larger Melee, Defensive, Offensive cooldown Icons
- Other small patches and fixes.
